name: offerpk-app-factory
summary: Offline game factory: builds one new offline casual game at a time (vanilla JS + Capacitor Android) as a new public OfferPk repo, with CI, GitHub Pages demo and APK artifact; when one is DONE it starts the next.
source: Original copy of sidecar.json.bak4 + AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md.bak4 from John's PC (game-factory mode, before the 2026-10-15 Shahdara focus). Not reconstructed. The later Shahdara-billing version is kept in variants/ for history only.
notes: It creates NEW repos itself (needs a GitHub MCP token with repo-create rights).
Today app-factory\AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md and STATE.md contain the Shahdara-billing version: use -RestoreFiles -Force to switch them back to game mode (old files are backed up).
Old game folders were moved to app-factory\work_old; the factory does not need them.
Do not run it at the same time as the Grok cloud routine 'Auto app factory' on the same repos.
